
local p = {}
local data2    = mw.loadData('Module:UnitData2/Data')
local data   = mw.loadData('Module:UnitData2/Data2')

function toNil(thing)
	if thing==nil or thing=='' then return nil else return thing end
end




local function mergeTables(dest, src)
    for key, value in pairs(src) do
        if type(value) == "table" and type(dest[key]) == "table" then
            mergeTables(dest[key], value) -- Рекурсивное слияние вложенных таблиц
        else
            dest[key] = value -- Простое присваивание значения
        end
    end
end

local data3 = {}

-- Объединение дублирующихся объектов
for character, characterData in pairs(data) do
    if data2[character] then
        local mergedData = {}

        -- Копирование данных из data
        mergeTables(mergedData, characterData)

        -- Копирование данных из data2
        mergeTables(mergedData, data2[character])

        data3[character] = mergedData
    end
end




function p.loli(f) 

function returnToText(data3)
    local function tableToString(tbl, indent)
        indent = indent or 0
        local str = ""
        local indentStr = string.rep("  ", indent)
        local keys = {}

        for k, v in pairs(tbl) do
            table.insert(keys, k)
        end

        table.sort(keys)

        for i, k in ipairs(keys) do
            local v = tbl[k]

            local keyStr
            if type(k) == "string" then
                keyStr = k
            else
                keyStr = "[" .. tostring(k) .. "]"
            end

            str = str .. indentStr .. keyStr .. " = "
            if type(v) == "table" then
                str = str .. "{\n" .. tableToString(v, indent + 1) .. indentStr .. "},"
            elseif type(v) == "string" then
                str = str .. '"' .. tostring(v) .. '",'
            else
                str = str .. tostring(v) .. ","
            end

            str = str .. "\n"
        end

        return str
    end

    return "data = {\n" .. tableToString(data, 1) .. "}"
end

return f:preprocess('<syntaxhighlight lang="lua" line>'.. returnToText(duplicateData) ..'</syntaxhighlight>')
	
	
end
